europe_now.title: Europe to join Russia-Ukraine peace negotiations
europe_now.summary: Ukrainian officials confirmed that European representatives will participate in the upcoming round of peace talks with Russia. President Zelenskyy and international mediators verified the development during ongoing diplomatic discussions.

sources.headline: 'Big development' in peace talks as Ukraine says Europe to join Russia negotiations
Zelensky welcomes US bringing Europe into Russia-Ukraine peace talks

europe_now.title: Global technology disruptions continue to affect Microsoft services
europe_now.summary: A massive global technology outage impacting Microsoft Outlook and related services entered its second day across numerous countries. Microsoft reported that it is working to resolve the issue while stating there is no evidence of malicious activity.

sources.headline: 'One of the biggest outages ever': Disruption to Microsoft services enters second day
🔴 Live: Microsoft 'not aware of any malicious activity' behind global Outlook outage

top_stories.title: Public Media Protests in Czechia
top_stories.summary: Czechia is preparing for large-scale demonstrations against planned financial cuts to public media institutions. Citizens and media advocates are organizing to protest the impending legislative changes.

sources.headline: Czechia braces for massive protest against cuts to public media

top_stories.title: European Public Support for Defense Integration
top_stories.summary: A recent survey indicates that a majority of European citizens strongly support the establishment of an independent EU military force. The findings emerge as regional security discussions continue among continental leaders.
